rv.q: The result is a serviceable production that lacks fresh revelations.
The result is a brisk rendition of the story performed in a little under four quick hours (including two intermissions) that showcases the versatility of a 16-actor ensemble.
Theater 'Henry IV': the Bard's nepo baby sheds two father figures and grows up (Off Broadway review) Date: February 9, 2025. Author: Thom Geier Henry V, a.k.a.

cn.t: Theatre for a New Audience completes its Shakespeare history cycle with a solid but unremarkable production of Henry IV, compressing both parts into one evening that captures the play's tricky blend of comedy and politics.
